			add = te_nation_src_inheritance_count
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_nation_src_resettlement > 0 }
			add = te_nation_src_resettlement_count
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_nation_src_transhumanism > 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_modifier = te_clade_parity_group }
				add = 1
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_modifier = te_clade_parity_none }
				add = 1
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_modifier = te_clade_parity_trait }
				add = 1
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_modifier = te_demog_um_devout }
				add = 1
			}
		}
	}
}
